purpose: Admin HTTP boundary for asset search, upload, metadata update, bulk assignment, and archive/remove.
businessRules: Admin key and role headers are required before asset data is exposed.
Search responses must remain in the SHRESTA ApiResponse envelope even when filters are empty.
Search, upload, metadata update, and bulk assignment support categoryProductTypeKey in addition to categoryFamilyKey so assets can be bound to category subcategories.
The admin asset surface is catalog/DAM scoped; brand/system chrome such as the SHRESTA logo is excluded by the repository layer.
Existing asset images can be replaced through a multipart endpoint that preserves assetKey and returns regenerated versioned S3-compatible media metadata.
Mutating endpoints require Idempotency-Key and run through IdempotentMutationCoordinator.
Multipart upload fingerprints include file metadata and request fields.
Admin responses are private no-store API envelopes with trace IDs.
